name: BROKEN TOP CLUB - GOLF MAINT
address: 367 SW MT WASHINGTON DR, BEND, OR 97702

fr.elements: Open Green Space; Detached Structure; Detached Structure; Walkway; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Lawn Area; Water Feature
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Limited Side Access; Multiple Structures
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the single driveway entrance so responders can confirm the correct property at night or in low visibility.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency apparatus to reach both structures without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the driveway so responding vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or blocks side access routes between and around the structures.
• Mark or number both structures visibly from the driveway so responders can immediately identify which structure they are approaching.
• Keep a clear path between the two structures so responders can move between them on foot without pushing through vegetation.
• Keep gates or barriers on side access routes unlocked or equipped with a lockbox so responders are not delayed reaching the rear of the property.
• Keep the area around the water feature clear so responders working near it are not at risk of an undetected drop-off or edge hazard.
• Identify and maintain at least one open staging area, such as the parking area or open lawn, that can accommodate an emergency vehicle or crew without blocking the access route.

wildfire.conditions: Open Green Space; Tree Cluster; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Brush Area; Vegetation Near Structure; Vegetation Near Structure; Mixed Vegetation; Grass Cover; Tall Grass Area; Dense Vegetation Nearby; Multiple Access Routes
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs and low-hanging branches that are directly touching or within a few feet of the house on all sides.
• Remove tall grass growing close to the base of the house and any attached or nearby structures.
• Cut or mow the tall grass area down before it dries out seasonally.
• Thin trees in the tree clusters nearest to the house to create gaps between the canopies.
• Remove low branches from scattered trees near the house so flames cannot climb from the ground into the tree tops.
• Clear dead plant material, fallen branches, and leaf litter from beneath the dense vegetation area closest to the house.
• Thin the brush area to break up the continuous mass of vegetation leading toward the house.
• Mow or cut the grass cover areas near the house and any outbuildings regularly during dry periods.
• Separate the mixed vegetation from the sides of the house by clearing a bare or short-mowed strip directly against the foundation.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and overgrown vegetation along the edges.
• Maintain enough clearance on each access route so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction from both sides.
• Remove any vegetation or debris that has grown into or over the edges of the driveway or secondary access paths.
